newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. There were 1,400 head confirmed for week to date. The last established price was 68.00-69.00 on Friday. Tuesay's packer bids are mostly 68.00, instance 69.00 in North Plains, with asking prices 70.00-71.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
